performance_conclusions_decision_provena.name: performance_conclusions_decision_provenance_check
performance_conclusions_decision_provena.value:
("performance_conclusions"."status" = 'applied'   AND "performance_conclusions"."applied_at" IS NOT NULL AND "performance_conclusions"."dismissed_at" IS NULL)
     OR ("performance_conclusions"."status" = 'dismissed' AND "performance_conclusions"."dismissed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "performance_conclusions"."applied_at" IS NULL)
     OR ("performance_conclusions"."status" = 'proposed'  AND "performance_conclusions"."applied_at" IS NULL AND "performance_conclusions"."dismissed_at" IS NULL)

audio_tracks_owner_check.name: audio_tracks_owner_check
audio_tracks_owner_check.value:
(sequence_id IS NOT NULL AND variant_id IS NULL)
     OR (sequence_id IS NULL AND variant_id IS NOT NULL)

sequence_clips_source_present_check.name: sequence_clips_source_present_check
sequence_clips_source_present_check.value:
(source_kind = 'generated'     AND source_variant_id IS NOT NULL)
     OR (source_kind = 'library_asset' AND source_asset_id   IS NOT NULL)
     OR (source_kind = 'upload'        AND upload_url        IS NOT NULL)
     OR source_missing_at IS NOT NULL

stage_states_number_kind_check.name: stage_states_number_kind_check
stage_states_number_kind_check.value: ("stage_number" = 1 and "stage_kind" = 'brief') or ("stage_number" = 2 and "stage_kind" = 'direction') or ("stage_number" = 3 and "stage_kind" = 'asset') or ("stage_number" = 4 and "stage_kind" = 'copy') or ("stage_number" = 5 and "stage_kind" = 'crops')

approvals_decided_together_check.name: approvals_decided_together_check
approvals_decided_together_check.value:
("approvals"."decided_at" is null and "approvals"."decision" is null and "approvals"."decided_by" is null)
          or ("approvals"."decided_at" is not null and "approvals"."decision" is not null and "approvals"."decided_by" is not null)

approvals_reason_only_on_needs_work_chec.name: approvals_reason_only_on_needs_work_check
approvals_reason_only_on_needs_work_chec.value:
("approvals"."reject_reason" is null and "approvals"."reject_stage_state_id" is null)
          or "approvals"."decision" = 'needs_work'
